proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b c hac hcb hf hd1 hd2 hg1 hg2 x hx
  rcases lt_trichotomy x c with h | rfl | h
  · have hsub : Set.Icc x c ⊆ Set.Icc a b := Set.Icc_subset_Icc hx.1 hcb
    obtain ⟨e, he1, he2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f g h (hf.mono hsub) (fun z hz => hd1 z ⟨hx.1.trans_lt hz.1, hz.2⟩)
    have := hg1 e ⟨hx.1.trans_lt he1.1, he1.2⟩
    have hpos : 0 < c - x := by linarith
    rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne'] at he2
    nlinarith
  · exact le_rfl
  · have hsub : Set.Icc c x ⊆ Set.Icc a b := Set.Icc_subset_Icc hac hx.2
    obtain ⟨e, he1, he2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f g h (hf.mono hsub) (fun z hz => hd2 z ⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans_le hx.2⟩)
    have := hg2 e ⟨he1.1, he1.2.trans_le hx.2⟩
    have hpos : 0 < x - c := by linarith
    rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne'] at he2
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), a ≤ c → c ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a c, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo c b, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a c, 0 ≤ g x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo c b, g x ≤ 0) → ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f c
